ne.is_delete = 0 AND ne.visibility = 1 AND ne.status = 1
and u.user_name like CONCAT('%',#{author},'%')
and c.name like CONCAT('%',#{categoryName},'%')
and (ne.title like CONCAT('%', #{keyWord}, '%') or ne.summary like CONCAT('%', #{keyWord}, '%'))
HAVING tags like CONCAT('%',#{tagName},'%')

ORDER BY ne.view_count DESC
ORDER BY ne.create_time DESC
